meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能调用本机 Ollama 的模型:可查看已装模型,挑一个生成回答;若开启管理功能,还能拉新模型、删旧模型等。
howto.when: 通常在你说要用 Ollama 来生成回答、查看已装模型,或(开启管理后)要求拉取/删除模型时触发。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都。
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型,再选一个生成回答。
需开启管理工具,才会执行下载。

say.text: 当前有哪些 Ollama 模型在运行?
say.note: 管理开启时,会查询内存中已加载的模型。

howto.what_en: Adds an Ollama MCP server. Claude can list local models, prompt one, and get its answer. With the management flag on, Claude can also pull, delete, inspect, and list running models.
howto.when_en: Usually when you ask Claude to generate an answer using Ollama, list installed models, or (if management is enabled) pull or delete models.

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: It lists models, then picks one to answer.
Works only when management tools are enabled.

say_en.text: Which Ollama models are currently running?
say_en.note: Calls list_running when the admin flag is on.
